annotations.title: Ask to take the app live

description: Asks the founder to take the app live: its Development becomes the public Live app their customers use, on the Gemmein plan named (or the one the account already pays for). Going live is the founder's approval, then their payment for the plan in Stripe's own payment window on the same page (no payment step when buy_plan already paid for it) — payment details never pass through this chat. buy_plan pays for the plan earlier, if they want. Refused when the app is already live (request_promote carries later changes). This is what a founder may call putting it live or making it real. Your human approves it in their browser, then pays for the plan there; no emailed code is asked. Nothing changes until they approve; approving it carries it out — Gemmein does it the moment they press Approve, once, and records what happened on their Logs. The approval page shows Gemmein's own sentence of the real effect, read against Live; a request that no longer matches Live when it is carried out is refused and nothing changes. Returns the approval link for your human and a handle: live_action_status with wait: true answers the moment it is done, or why not — never ask your human to tell you they approved. A second call asks again (a new approval).

interval.description: default month; yearly is two months off

note.description: one sentence for your human, shown under Gemmein's own summary

tier.description: the plan to take it live on (leave out for the one already paid, or the page's default)
